name: Drefa
desc:
Drefa is an Etrean NPC.

When interacted with, they request 6 wood in order to keep the fires lit. In exchange, the Pathfinder gains 5 Notes and increased Reputation with [Etrea](faction:etrea). They also give the Pathfinder a free Lumber Axe if they do not have one.

Their counterpart in [Etris](location:etris) is [Korin](entity:drefa).
additional_info: -   Drefa's racial variant appears to be Coral.
